title: Appearance
description: One language for Reelix, on every device. The theme is kept in this browser.
matchDeviceDescription: {{dark}} when the device is dark, {{light}} when it is light.
languageHint: Everything follows it: pages, dates and numbers, titles and overviews from TMDB, the agent's own messages, inbox notices and Telegram. The agent still answers in whatever language you write to it.
makeYourOwn: Themes are folders in {{dir}}: copy one with “reelix theme new”, or ask the agent to make one.
